_note: The Oracle's blessings catalog — data-driven, tweakable, extendable anytime. Grandmother can do whatever she wants with her kids: add a blessing here and it's in the repertoire. Effects are descriptive until the Oracles system is built, at which point they become the effects spec. (Owner: Hans, 2026-10-06. See design/oracle-gifts-daily.md.)

blessings.description: Resource harvest amounts increased across her planet.
blessings.if_then: IF harvest yields are lagging OR as a free-spirit gift
blessings.name: Bountiful Harvest

blessings.if_then: IF war footing is rising OR as a free-spirit gift
blessings.name: Swift Muster

blessings.description: Better drops from Chorus raids; rare drops (chipsets, artifacts) more frequent.
blessings.if_then: IF players are raiding Chorus sites heavily OR a hot site is named in the daily word
blessings.name: Chorus Spoils

blessings.description: Her people take less damage — strength, health, cover effectiveness up.
blessings.if_then: IF an enemy beachhead is populating OR player raids are spiking against her people
blessings.name: Grandmother's Shield

blessings.description: Her people hit harder — damage and kill rate up. Can make a G5 bastion manageable.
blessings.if_then: IF her people are assaulting a hard target (G4/G5) OR a beachhead must be broken
blessings.name: Grandmother's Wrath

blessings.description: The Chorus weakens — their lines a little softer, their aim a little worse.
blessings.if_then: IF her people face overwhelming Chorus strength
blessings.name: Softened Chorus

blessings.description: Public honor by name in the daily word, plus a blessing. The blessing fits the growth: rose in reverb → blessed all around; rose in membership/retention → donated materials.
blessings.if_then: IF an alliance grew the most (members, power/reverb, tier levels) that day
blessings.name: Alliance Laurels

blessings.description: She says nothing and only smiles. May carry a small hidden bonus — or nothing at all. The planet learns to wonder.
blessings.name: Grandmother's Smile

blessings.description: She does not like civil war. When her citizens fight each other, she scolds them publicly in the daily word — by name if needed.
blessings.name: Grandmother's Rebuke
